newsitem.title: USA: Gulfmark involved in spin-off, merger.
newsitem.headline: Gulfmark involved in spin-off, merger.

text.p: Gulfmark International Inc said Thursday it would spin off to shareholders all shares of a newly formed publicly traded company that would acquire all assets of Gulfmark's marine transportation business and assume certain associated liabilities, and following the spin-off, Energy Ventures Inc would acquire Gulfmark.
The company said Energy Ventures would acquire Gulfmark for 2.2 million shares of Energy Venture stock.
Gulfmark said its stockholders would receive 0.6695 shares of Energy Ventures common stock for each share of Gulfmark common stock.

In a separate release Thursday, Energy Ventures said the acquisition is expected to increase its stockholder base as well as allow for a profitable low-cost business, with potential synergies with its own businesses.
Energy Ventures said the deal is expected to close in the first quarter of 1997.
